usageNotes: Returns the list of node names participating in the Corosync cluster quorum as defined in the cluster configuration. Use this to enumerate cluster members before targeting node-specific operations. Note that this reflects the configured node list, not live membership — a node may be listed here but currently offline.
tips: This endpoint reads the static cluster config (/etc/pve/corosync.conf), not real-time quorum state — use the cluster status endpoint to check which nodes are actually online.
Requires Sys.Audit on the root path; API tokens with that privilege work without additional scoping.
Each returned 'node' value matches the node name used in other node-scoped paths (e.g., /nodes/{node}/...).
